mapper.select: SELECT CODE as symbol, CYCLE as period, EXTRACT(epoch FROM date + '-8 hour') *1000::INTEGER AS timestamp, OPEN, HIGH, LOW, CLOSE, VOL as volume FROM FU_BAR_INFO WHERE CODE=#{symbol} and CYCLE=#{period}

SELECT t.symbol, 'W' as period, max(t.timestamp) as timestamp, min(t.open) as OPEN, max(t.close) as CLOSE, MIN(LOW) as LOW, MAX(HIGH) as HIGH, SUM(volume) as VOLUME FROM ( select CODE as symbol, CYCLE as period, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE)*1000 as timestamp, YEARWEEK(DATE) as wk, FIRST_VALUE(OPEN) OVER (PARTITION BY CODE, CYCLE, YEARWEEK(date) ORDER BY date ASC) as open, LAST_VALUE(CLOSE) OVER (PARTITION BY CODE, CYCLE, YEARWEEK(date) ORDER BY date ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) as close, HIGH, LOW, VOL as volume from fu_bar_info where CODE=#{symbol} and CYCLE='D'
) t GROUP BY t.symbol, t.period, t.wk

SELECT s.symbol, '${period}' as period, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(TIMESTAMP(s.d,s.m))*1000 as timestamp, MIN(s.OPEN) as open, max(s.HIGH) as high, MIN(s.LOW) as low, MAX(s.CLOSE) as close, SUM(s.volume) as volume FROM ( SELECT CODE as symbol, CYCLE as period, DATE(DATE) d, m.cycle_${period} m, FIRST_VALUE(OPEN) OVER (PARTITION BY CODE, CYCLE, DATE(DATE), m.cycle_${period} ORDER BY date ASC) as open, LAST_VALUE(CLOSE) OVER (PARTITION BY CODE, CYCLE, DATE(DATE), m.cycle_${period} ORDER BY date ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) as close, HIGH, LOW,VOL as volume from FU_BAR_INFO t LEFT JOIN FU_MIN_MAPPING m ON m.cycle_5m=time(t.DATE) where CODE=#{symbol} and CYCLE='5M'
) s GROUP BY s.symbol, s.period, s.d, s.m
